name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
steps: Set an incline bench to roughly a 30 to 45-degree angle.
Straddle the bench and lie chest-down against the pad, holding a pair of dumbbells with arms extended straight toward the floor.
Plant your feet firmly on the ground behind you to stabilize your body.
Pull your elbows back past your torso, retracting your shoulder blades and squeezing your upper back muscles at the top.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down until your arms are fully extended.
coaching_cues: Keep your chest in contact with the pad throughout; do not arch your lower back off the bench.
Pull your elbows back toward your hips rather than straight up to your ears.
Exhale as you row up and inhale as you lower.
